name: backend-ms
description: DDD Microservices Architecture with gRPC, RabbitMQ, and API Gateway

scripts.install:all: for dir in services/*; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ]; then (cd "$dir" && npm install); fi; done
scripts.build:all: for dir in services/*; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ]; then (cd "$dir" && npm run build); fi; done
